summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 26, 2026. The filing provides notice of the meeting but does not disclose any specific proposals, resolutions, or special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. The EGM appears to be a routine procedural event under Cayman Islands law. There are no deal terms, advisor appointments, or structural changes mentioned. As a routine meeting notice with no underlying event, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
